notes.title: Dragon Front: Adventures Demo - Patch 2
notes.content:
Greetings Intrepid Adventurers,

Patch 2 for the Dragon Front: Adventures Demo is now live!  This is a broad range of general quality of life improvements to improve your excursions into Terrene Gall.

[b]Addressed Issues:
[/b][list]
[*]Removed Trailer from defeat screen. 
[*]Allow Officer Keyring relic to be activated using Controller while hovering over an existing chest. 
[*]Improved functionality of controller on rewards screen.  
[*]Improved functionality of controller on Champion select screen. 
[*]Fixed a softlock that can happen if the deck list is brought up at the beginning of the battle victory sequence. 
[*]Fix for backing out of options menu, Trader, and Campfire screens with controller. 
[*]Tribe banner text no longer shows up on hovered last played cards if card does not have a Tribe. 
[/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed a softlock that can happen if the deck list is brought up at the beginning of the battle victory sequence.
- Fix for backing out of options menu, Trader, and Campfire screens with controller.
- Tribe banner text no longer shows up on hovered last played cards if card does not have a Tribe.

notes.title: Dragon Front: Adventures Demo - Patch 1
notes.content:
Greetings Intrepid Adventurers,

Patch 1 for the Dragon Front: Adventures Demo is now live!  This is a broad range of general quality of life improvements to improve your excursions into Terrene Gall.

[b]Addressed Issues:
[/b][list]
[*]Addressed an AMD GPU out of Memory crash.
[*]Default Graphical quality and shadows is now set to medium.
[*]Improved the transition from Faction Select to Champion Select.
[*]Unavailable factions are now correctly locked on the faction select.
[*]In-game trailer has been updated.
[*]The trailer video is now skippable with Start/Esc.
[*]Addressed various typos.
[*]Banners for earlier battles now start with 5 health.
[*]Fixes boss positioning on Region Map.
[*]Fixed return to map button not showing hover visual correctly.
[*]Addressed issues with various visual effects.
[*]Abandon run prompt now properly updates.
[*]Unreal logo now fades properly with the text.
[/list]
[b]Known Issue Being Investigated:
[/b][list]
[*]There is a blue tint to Thorns Portal battles on Medium and Low settings. As a work around, changing the shadow quality back and forth will clear the blue tint.  
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Addressed an AMD GPU out of Memory crash.
[*]Unavailable factions are now correctly locked on the faction select.
[*]Fixed return to map button not showing hover visual correctly.
[*]Unreal logo now fades properly with the text.
